title: Fixed-width binary addition words
statement: Let $m,n,k$ be natural numbers such that $m+n<2^k$. The concatenation of the $k$-bit representations of $m$, $n$, and $m+n$ belongs to the Boolean addition language, whose words encode three equally long bit strings with the value of the third equal to the sum of the first two.
